acquisition_method.evidence: MS data were acquired in data-independent mode (DIA) with minor changes from previously described method.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were then alkylated with iodoacetamide (final concentration 20 mM) and incubated for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were then alkylated with iodoacetamide (final concentration 20 mM) and incubated for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: 125 µL of enzyme solution (1.8 µg Promega trypsin /Lys-C mix in 50 mM TEAB) was added to each well of the dried plate and incubated for one hour at 37°C in a water-saturated atmosphere.

collision_energy.evidence: DIA MS2 scans were then acquired using the tMSn scan function at 30K orbitrap resolution over 40 scan windows with variable width, with a normalized AGC target of 1000%, maximum injection time set to auto and a 30 % collision energy.

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were analysed by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) with an Ultimate 3000 HPLC coupled to an Orbitrap Ascend Tribrid instrument (Thermo Fisher) using a nano-EASY spray source.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: MS1 scans were collected in the orbitrap at a resolving power of 45K at m/z 200 over m/z range of 350 – 1650 m/z.
